say:2:1421417001:1.text: I stationed guards at the essence pool. They'll keep an eye on each other—nothing should go wrong for now.
say:2:1421417001:1.source_cn: 我已经安排了卫队去把守蛋液池，如果只是短时间，他们相互...

say:3:1421417002:1.text: Once I ensured everything was in order, I returned immediately to meet up with you. And yet, to my surprise, I still arrived first.
say:3:1421417002:1.source_cn: 安排好了以后我第一时间就返回来与你们会合，没想到你们反...

say:4:1421417003:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I doubt this was your doing. Must've been Ravion, dawdling as usual.

say:4:1421417003:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I doubt this was your doing. Must've been Ravion, dawdling as usual.

say:7:1421417004:1.text: Oh, come now, no need to sound so put out! I was simply giving our dear friend here a delightful little tour of my childhood residence. Indris, must you always be so rigid?
say:7:1421417004:1.source_cn: 只是稍微耽误了点时间，带我亲爱的魔法师朋友参观一下我的...
say:7:1421417004:1.male: Oh, come now, no need to sound so put out! I was simply giving our dear friend here a delightful little tour of my childhood residence. Indris, must you always be so rigid?
say:7:1421417004:1.female: Oh, come now, no need to sound so put out! I was simply giving our dear friend here a delightful little tour of my childhood residence. Indris, must you always be so rigid?

say:8:1421417006:2.text: Anyway, you arrived just in time. Let's get to work.
say:8:1421417006:2.source_cn: 总之，你来得正好，我们就一起在这里检查一下吧。

say:9:1421417007:1.text: Look at this. Documents everywhere, already picked through. A complete mess...
say:9:1421417007:1.source_cn: 看，这里到处都是已经被筛选过一轮，失去了部分价值但仍然...

say:10:1421417008:1.text: For the record, when my mother was alive, this place was pristine. Now? Thanks to certain... visitors, it's a disaster.
say:10:1421417008:1.source_cn: 事先声明，母亲生前这里还是很整齐的，只是现在托了某些朋...

say:11:1421417009:1.text: I have to admit, I still feel uneasy being here. Sorting intelligence is one thing, but rifling through your mother's personal belongings...
say:11:1421417009:1.source_cn: 这是你母亲的私人住所，筛查情报也就算了，私人物品之类的...

say:13:1421417010:1.text: Oh, don't be so uptight! You should know I haven't set foot in here since I came of age. Do you know what that means?
say:13:1421417010:1.source_cn: 别客气，你要知道，我成年以后就再也没有踏足过此处——知...

say:14:1421417011:1.text: Remember the last time you came here? Dear Indris, you were the first outsider to ever set foot in my mother's chambers!
say:14:1421417011:1.source_cn: 亲爱的因度厄，也就是你，是第一位有幸踏入我母亲寝殿深处...

choice_prompt:15:1421417011.text: Remember the last time you came here? Dear Indris, you were the first outsider to ever set foot in my mother's chambers!
choice_prompt:15:1421417011.source_cn: 亲爱的因度厄，也就是你，是第一位有幸踏入我母亲寝殿深处的外人！

say:16:1421417012:1.text: Correct! And your dwarven friend makes three! Congratulations, you've made history!
say:16:1421417012:1.source_cn: 没错，你们的矮人朋友则是第三个！棒极了，你们开启了全新...
say:16:1421417012:1.male: Correct! And your dwarven friend makes three! Congratulations, you've made history!
say:16:1421417012:1.female: Correct! And your dwarven friend makes three! Congratulations, you've made history!

say:17:1421417014:1.text: So, Indris, will you be searching over here, or would you rather inspect the spot where you were once so charmingly restrained? Either works for me.
say:17:1421417014:1.source_cn: 所以，别客气了，因度厄，来，你翻这边，还是说，你想翻你...

say:18:1421417015:1.text: ...I'll just supervise you two from the side.

say:20:1421417013:1.text: If you win the championship, does it really matter what you're wearing? I'd think a mage with a taste for eccentric fashion would agree.
say:20:1421417013:1.source_cn: 只要能拿到冠军，就不要在意他打扮成什么样——喜欢奇装异...
say:20:1421417013:1.male: If you win the championship, does it really matter what you're wearing? I'd think a mage with a taste for eccentric fashion would agree.
say:20:1421417013:1.female: If you win the championship, does it really matter what you're wearing? I'd think a mage with a taste for eccentric fashion would agree.

choice:15:1:2.text: Even though we were in cuffs!
choice:15:1:2.male: Even though we were in cuffs!
choice:15:1:2.female: Even though we were in cuffs!

say:21:1421417005:1.text: Hahaha! See? Indris, our dear Merlin is far more forgiving than you.
say:21:1421417005:1.source_cn: 哈哈哈，看吧，因度厄，我们的梅林大人可是比你要温和得多呢。
say:21:1421417005:1.male: Hahaha! See? Indris, our dear Merlin is far more forgiving than you.
say:21:1421417005:1.female: Hahaha! See? Indris, our dear Merlin is far more forgiving than you.
